title: Associated quotient sheaf and restricted structure-sheaf pushforward
statement: Let i:Z\to Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], U an affine open, A=\Gamma(Y,U), and I an ideal of A. Let e:i^{-1}(U)\simeq\operatorname{Spec}(A/I) be an isomorphism such that i|_U followed by U\to\operatorname{Spec}A equals e followed by the quotient-spectrum morphism. Then the associated sheaf of the A-module A/I [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections], restricted along U\simeq\operatorname{Spec}A, is isomorphic as an O_U-module to the restriction to U of i_*O_Z [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pc-module-pullback].

source.place: Lemma 26.7.3(2), Tag 01I9 (lemma-widetilde-pullback); specialize to the quotient morphism and transport along the affine chart. This supplies the identification implicit in More on Morphisms, Tag 068C.

proof.text: Apply isIso_fromTildeΓ_pushforward to the structure module on Spec(A/I). Identify its global sections as A/I with restricted scalars using pushforwardSpecMapCompΓIso and tilde.isoTop. Apply tilde to this sections isomorphism and compose with the invertible tilde-Gamma counit. This realizes the affine spectrum pushforward comparison.

Restriction along a scheme isomorphism is isomorphic to pushforward along its inverse: combine pushforward composition, pushforward identity and the restriction adjunction counit. Apply this to the affine chart and quotient presentation e. The equality he identifies e.hom followed by the quotient spectrum map and the inverse affine chart with i restricted to U. Compose the corresponding pushforward isomorphisms. Finally, identify restriction of i_*O_Z to U with pushforward of O_Z restricted to i^{-1}U using the canonical sectionwise restriction comparison. Its scalar compatibility is morphismRestrict_app; restrictions of structure modules are given by restrictUnitIso.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 26.7.3(2), Tag 01I9, specialized to the quotient; canonical categorical transport along the affine chart and restriction to an open.

mathlib_searches.query: The pushforward of the structure sheaf along a quotient spectrum morphism is the sheaf associated to the quotient module
For a quotient ring A/I, the pushforward of the structure sheaf of Spec(A/I) to Spec A is the associated sheaf of the A-module A/I

theorem affine_quotient_restricted_iso {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (U : Y.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (I : Ideal (Γ(Y, U)))
    (e : Scheme.Opens.toScheme (i ⁻¹ᵁ U) ≅
      Spec (CommRingCat.of ((Γ(Y, U) : Type u) ⧸ I)))
    (he : i ∣_ U ≫ U.toSpecΓ =
      e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) :
    Nonempty (((tilde.functor Γ(Y, U) ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor hU.isoSpec.hom).obj
        (ModuleCat.of (Γ(Y, U) : Type u) ((Γ(Y, U) : Type u) ⧸ I))) ≅
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))))
